chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to Bashir al-Nabbal:
When you are granted provision from something, remain committed to it.

key_terms.النَّبَّالِ: the arrow-maker or arrow-seller, a descriptive epithet
key_terms.رُزِقْتَ: you are granted provision or sustenance
key_terms.شَيْءٍ: a thing; here, a means or source
key_terms.فَالْزَمْهُ: then keep to it; remain committed to it

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about staying committed to a source of livelihood?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that when a person is provided sustenance through a certain means, he should adhere to it. The saying encourages steadiness and contentment in one's livelihood.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3636 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said to Bishir al-Nabbal:
"When you are granted provision from something, remain committed to it."
